facts.fact: The Central Bank of the Republic of Guinea launched the NimbaPay project in December 2025, and NimbaPay, the national instant payment system, was officially launched on 22 July 2026 connecting banks, e-money operators and other institutions.

The governor's 36% access figure names no survey.

facts.fact: BCRG Governor Karamo Kaba said access to financial services rose from 4% in 2011 to nearly 36% in 2024, driven partly by the expansion of electronic money.
NimbaPay, launched on 22 July 2026, enables transfers between bank accounts, mobile wallets and other financial accounts across different providers.
NimbaPay, the national instant payment system launched on 22 July 2026, connects banks, electronic money operators and other financial institutions.
